definitions.name: W1C.DELTA
definitions.note: Bracket String to the Vector of +1 for each opener and -1 for each closer.

definitions.name: W1C.CODE
definitions.note: Bracket String to the Vector of codes: ( is 1, [ is 2, ) is -1, ] is -2.

definitions.name: W1C.STEP3
definitions.body: 'K' BIND 'X' BIND X 1220703125 G0A.MOD 'S' BIND X 1220703125 DIV FLOOR 'L' BIND S 5 DIV FLOOR S 5 MUL K 0 MAX ADD S 5 G0A.MOD K ADD 0 EQ SELECT 'S2' BIND L 1 SUB L 1 ADD S 5 G0A.MOD K ADD 0 EQ SELECT 'L2' BIND S2 L2 1220703125 MUL ADD
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step on X = stack + 5^13 * count, the stack being base-5 digits (openers 1 or 2, unmatched closers 0); a closer pops when its digit matches.

definitions.name: W1C.JOINSP
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined by single spaces with no space at either end.

definitions.name: W1C.CAP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Word String with its first letter upper case and the rest lower case.

definitions.name: W1C.LONGER
definitions.body: 'P' BIND 'A' BIND P A P CHARS LENGTH A CHARS LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over Strings: the longer of word and accumulator, the accumulator on ties.

definitions.name: W1C.PICK
definitions.body: 'P' BIND 'A' BIND P A 2 COLLECT 0 1 P 1 GET A 1 GET GT SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step over [key value] pairs or entries: the element whose second item is strictly larger, the accumulator on ties.

definitions.name: W1C.RECPAIRS
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Record to the Vector of [key value] pairs in key order.

definitions.name: W1C.ARGMAX
definitions.body: W1C.RECPAIRS 'PR' BIND PR PR 0 GET [ W1C.PICK ] FOLD 0 GET
definitions.note: Record to the key whose value is largest, the first key on ties.

definitions.name: W1C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP 'N' BIND E [ 1 GET ] MAP 'A' BIND N A GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to a Record from name to the sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: W1C.RUNPAIR
definitions.body: 'G' BIND G 0 GET G LENGTH 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Vector of equal values to the two-element Vector [value count].

definitions.name: W1C.RUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND [ 1 ] V 1 DROP V -1 DROP SUB 'D' BIND 1 0 D D MUL 0 GT SELECT CONCAT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN V GROUP
definitions.note: Vector to a Record from run number to the values of that maximal run of equal adjacent values, in run order.

definitions.name: W1C.FSTEP
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step that carries the last present reading forward over a missing one.

definitions.name: W1C.RUNSTEP
definitions.body: 'M' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 M SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over truths: length of the current run of TRUE values, reset to 0 on FALSE.

definitions.name: W1C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S S LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR S LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector: mean of the middle one or two sorted values.

solutions.brackets.depth: W1C.DELTA 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: W1C.CODE 'C' BIND C 0 [ W1C.STEP3 ] SCAN 'XS' BIND 1 C LENGTH RANGE C LENGTH TAKE 0 XS 1220703125 LT SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: W1C.BYNAME W1C.RECPAIRS [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E 0 GET [ W1C.PICK ] FOLD
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ W1C.CAP ] MAP W1C.JOINSP
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT W1C.JOINSP
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W 0 GET [ W1C.LONGER ] FOLD
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND [ 1 ] V 1 DROP V -1 DROP SUB 'D' BIND 0 1 D 0 GT SELECT CONCAT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN V GROUP VALUES [ LENGTH ] MAP G0C.MAXV
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V TALLY W1C.RECPAIRS [ 1 GET 2 MUL N GT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET 'F' BIND V F [ W1C.FSTEP ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? ] MAP 'M' BIND [ FALSE ] M -1 DROP CONCAT 'P' BIND M P NOT AND G0B.COUNT
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ W1C.RUNSTEP ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'M' BIND V M DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V W1C.MEDIAN 'MD' BIND V MD SUB 'D' BIND D 0 D SUB MAX W1C.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: 'V' BIND V TALLY W1C.RECPAIRS 'P' BIND P [ 1 GET ] MAP G0C.MAXV 'M' BIND P [ 1 GET M LT NOT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP SORT 0 GET
solutions.series.trimmed: SORT 'S' BIND S 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
